preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 100,000.
The adjacency list must have a length equal to the number of vertices V.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list must be valid indices within the range of 0 to V-1.

postconditions.description: Each edge in the output list must contain exactly two vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(edge[0] < edge[1] for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each edge in the output list must be sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(edge in return_value for edge in critical_edges)
postconditions.description: The output list must contain all critical edges identified in the graph.
